text: Across the windswept roads of Azeroth, {what} now journey toward you, {name}. May the realm remember this day of wise and generous mailing.
Hark! From the vaults of one weary traveler, a parcel departs, bearing the fate of many future crafts.
Long was the road, and many the bandits slain, yet these {what} have reached you at last, {name}.
In the age of overflowing bags, a hero chose sacrifice. Behold the contents of this humble parcel.
The ancient prophecy foretold a mailbox, a parcel, and a very full bank. Today the prophecy is fulfilled.
Hey {name}, just sending over some {what}, since they were apparently living rent-free in my bags. No pressure to ever say thanks!
I noticed the bank slots were getting a bit crowded, so I sent these along. Totally fine if you were not planning on using them.
Not to be dramatic, but I have been carrying these {what} for three whole weeks. They are yours now. Enjoy!
Oh, you will find a parcel in your mailbox. Again. Because someone has to keep the guild bank organized.
Sending you some stuff, {name}. If it goes missing in your bags, I definitely will not notice or mention it at all.
And the parcel is away! Beautiful lob from the bank to the mailbox, {name} is in position, this is textbook crafting logistics!
Folks, what a play! {what} sent across the realm with ten minutes left on the cooldown. The crowd goes wild!
The sender winds up, clicks Send, and scores! A flawless delivery to the alt, absolutely clinical.
Replay that mail drop in slow motion, {name}! Perfect form, zero postage wasted, a champion of inventory management.
It is a packed bag versus an empty bank, and the mailbox just made the winning assist. Unbelievable!
Er, {name}, friend, here are your {what}. Very safe, very legal, no need to count them, but you might count them, ha!
Please do not tell the auctioneer I let these go so cheap. Free of charge, just between us, yes yes?
I sent the goods, I swear on my last copper! Did they arrive? Please say they arrived. Please.
Quick, take this parcel before my boss sees! Totally honest shipment, nothing suspicious inside, mostly.
Oh dear, oh dear, so many {what} and so little time. Please be gentle with them, {name}, they cost me dearly!
{name}, I am so proud of how you have grown. Here are some {what} to help you on your next adventure!
Look at you, leveling all by yourself! I packed a little parcel of supplies, so remember to eat and craft.
I gathered every last one of these just for you, and I could not be prouder. Use them well, sweetheart!
My little crafter is going places. Here is a care package from home, and do not forget to wear your armor.
Your hard work has not gone unnoticed, {name}. Enjoy these {what}, you have earned every single one.
